### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: E&F's own common/production_methods/15_ef_bank.txt
### and common/production_methods/00_ef_market_liquidity.txt.
###
### The WHOLE production method is restated, with the good swapped -- not just
### `building_modifiers`.
###
### The first build restated only building_modifiers, on the theory that REPLACE:
### swaps the sub-blocks a mod names and leaves the rest. In game the central
### bank then offered all 95 currencies in its dropdown, though every
### pm_currency_* carries `unlocking_laws` and `is_hidden_when_unavailable = yes`.
### That is what a lost `unlocking_laws` looks like. Whether REPLACE: really
### replaces the entry wholesale for production methods was not worth another
### round of guessing: emitting the full block is correct under either rule.
###
### The cost is that texture, unlocking_laws and is_hidden_when_unavailable are
### now pinned to E&F. The generator re-derives them from E&F on every run, so
### they cannot drift -- but this file MUST be rebuilt after an E&F update.
###
### All 95 currencies are retargeted, not just the 56 whose goods we remove: E&F
### ships 95 laws and 95 PMs against 57 goods, so 38 of these already pointed at
### goods their own author had commented out.
###
### 95 of the pm_currency_* got their own currency icon instead of the
### shared currency_type.dds.
###
### is_hidden_when_unavailable is KEPT, and one build dropped it by mistake. The
### missing "Currency Issued" row in the bank panel looked like a group with
### nothing to choose between; it is not. E&F hides that group by name in
### building_details_panel.gui, and the flag has nothing to do with it. With the
### flag the row lists two entries, the country's currency and "no currency";
### without it, all ninety-six.

### pm_currency_* -- 95 currencies

REPLACE:pm_currency_dinar_currency = {
	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/goods_icons/currencies/dinar.dds"
	is_hidden_when_unavailable = yes

	unlocking_laws = {
		law_dinar_currency
	}
	building_modifiers = {
		workforce_scaled = {
			goods_output_spe_uni_c_add = 1
		}
	}
}
